title: Legged robot locomotion
description: Develop control algorithms that let four-legged robots walk over uneven terrain. Students tune controllers in simulation and test them on hardware.

title: Warehouse robot arm grasping
description: Teach a robotic manipulator to pick irregular objects from bins using depth cameras and learned grasp detection.

title: Underwater vehicle mapping
description: Program autonomous underwater vehicles to map reservoir floors with sonar and plan efficient survey paths.

title: Medical image segmentation
description: Train neural networks to outline tumors in MRI scans and measure agreement with radiologists.

title: Fake news detection with language models
description: Fine-tune transformer language models to flag misleading social media posts and study annotator disagreement.

title: Speech recognition for Appalachian dialects
description: Collect and transcribe regional speech recordings and adapt automatic speech recognition models to underrepresented dialects.

title: Crop yield prediction from satellites
description: Combine satellite imagery and weather records to forecast corn and soybean yields across Virginia counties.

title: Headwater stream chemistry
description: Measure nitrate and phosphorus in mountain streams after storms and relate pollution pulses to land use.

title: Wetland bird surveys
description: Conduct dawn point counts of marsh birds and model how habitat restoration affects species occupancy.

title: Pollinator decline on farmland
description: Track bumblebee visits to wildflowers on restored farmland and test pesticide exposure in hive samples.

title: Concrete durability with recycled glass
description: Cast and test concrete mixes containing recycled glass to evaluate cracking and freeze-thaw durability.

title: Bridge vibration monitoring
description: Install vibration sensors on pedestrian bridges and analyze signals to detect structural damage early.

title: Battery cathode synthesis
description: Synthesize new cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries and characterize them with X-ray diffraction.

title: Wind turbine blade aerodynamics
description: Run computational fluid dynamics simulations of turbine blades and validate predictions in the wind tunnel.

title: Small satellite attitude control
description: Design and test the pointing control system for a student-built CubeSat mission.

title: Game engine physics optimization
description: Profile and speed up physics simulation code in an open-source game engine.

title: Smart home device security
description: Find vulnerabilities in consumer Internet of Things devices through firmware analysis and network traffic inspection.

title: Social app privacy attitudes
description: Interview and survey college students about how they manage privacy settings on social apps.

title: Toddler vocabulary growth
description: Record toddlers playing with parents and code how vocabulary grows between 18 and 30 months.

title: Adolescent sleep and mood
description: Use wearable trackers and daily diaries to study how sleep affects teenagers' mood and stress.

title: Civil War letters digitization
description: Transcribe and annotate soldiers' letters from the Civil War era and publish them in an online archive.

title: Renaissance choral manuscripts
description: Edit and encode sixteenth-century choral music manuscripts for a digital edition.

title: Village savings groups
description: Analyze loan repayment data from village savings groups to understand financial inclusion.

title: Investor sentiment and stock returns
description: Relate online investor sentiment to daily stock returns using text mining and econometric models.

title: School cafeteria menus
description: Evaluate how redesigned school cafeteria menus change what elementary students eat and waste.

title: Appalachian overdose mapping
description: Map county-level overdose trends in Appalachia and examine access to treatment facilities.

title: Cattle rumen microbiome
description: Sequence rumen microbes in beef cattle and link community composition to feed efficiency.

title: Tick-borne disease surveillance
description: Drag-sample ticks in state parks and test them for Lyme disease bacteria with PCR.

title: Accessible university websites
description: Redesign university web pages for screen-reader users and run usability tests with blind participants.

title: Urban heat islands
description: Deploy temperature loggers across Roanoke neighborhoods and relate heat exposure to tree canopy and income.
